_comment: Suite wayfinding SSOT. Steps are ordered. Surfaces within each step are ordered. To INSERT a step (e.g. 'Authorize' before 'run'), add a new entry at the desired index and update the 'num' fields — layout is driven by array position, not by num. To add a surface, append to the step's 'surfaces' array. The generator (scripts/gen-wayfinder.mjs) reads this file and re-renders on every build.

_insertNotes.Authorize_before_Run: Insert {id:'authorize', num:2, label:'Authorize', one_line_role:'Sign work mandates that govern what agents may run', surfaces:[...]} at index 1. Increment num of all subsequent steps. Update the lit-step values in each page's WAYFINDER sentinel.
_insertNotes.VM_inside_Run: Add {name:'Kernel VM', url:'https://ainumbers.co/chaingraph/kernel-vm.html', audience:'both'} to step 'run' surfaces array.
_insertNotes.BX1_inside_Run: Add {name:'Boundary Explorer', url:'https://ainumbers.co/chaingraph/boundary-explorer.html', audience:'both'} to step 'run' surfaces.
_insertNotes.ML3_inside_Verify: Add {name:'Exception Queue', url:'https://ledger.ainumbers.co/', audience:'human'} to step 'verify' surfaces (same Ledger URL; Exceptions view is a tab).
